title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey R.J., it's ███████ Fenech from the Free Press. Good seeing you. Hope you got home safe and good luck the rest of the way. Save my number.
Got ya saved ███████, I appreciate your interest in the Area guy side of things. Good seeing you as well and I look forward to seeing ya down the road.
No worries, I was happy to see you there. Congrats again.
Trade deadline is going to be interesting
